cues: And strike these phrases out of your English.
Myself Ramesh Thapa: say I am Ramesh Thapa, or better, open with the issue.
Kindly do the needful: say what the needful is.
Your's faithfully, with an apostrophe: there is no apostrophe in yours.
I beg to state: a hundred years out of date.
And reply back: reply already means back.
text: And strike these phrases out of your English. Myself Ramesh Thapa: say I am Ramesh Thapa, or better, open with the issue. Kindly do the needful: say what the needful is. Your's faithfully, with an apostrophe: there is no apostrophe in yours. Respected sir: dear sir. I beg to state: a hundred years out of date. And reply back: reply already means back.
